staff-pose: Change her pose: she UNCROSSES her legs completely — both legs now stretched out STRAIGHT together in front of her flat on the mat, toes pointing up, back perfectly upright at a right angle to her legs, palms flat on the mat beside her hips, arms straight.
butterfly: Change her pose: she brings the SOLES OF HER FEET TOGETHER pressed against each other in front of her pelvis, knees bent and dropped open wide to the sides toward the mat, hands holding her feet, back upright.
seated-forward-fold: Change her pose: she sits with both legs stretched out STRAIGHT together in front of her flat on the mat, and folds her torso FORWARD OVER HER LEGS, chest toward the thighs, hands reaching toward her feet, head relaxed down.
wide-angle-seated-fold: Change her pose: she sits with both legs stretched out STRAIGHT and spread WIDE APART on the mat in a V shape, and leans her torso forward between her legs, hands on the mat in front of her.
chair: Small correction: her two feet are now together side by side, parallel and touching, both flat on the floor — not staggered one in front of the other. Everything else unchanged: knees bent like sitting in an invisible chair, arms raised overhead.
dolphin: Change her pose: from all fours she lowers onto her FOREARMS (elbows and forearms flat on the mat) and lifts her HIPS UP HIGH toward the ceiling, legs straight, feet flat on the mat — an inverted V shape resting on the forearms, head between the arms.
half-moon: Change her pose: she balances on her left leg with her LEFT HAND ON THE MAT below her shoulder, her right leg lifted STRAIGHT and HORIZONTAL behind her at hip height, her right arm pointing straight up, torso facing sideways.
crow: Change her pose: she is in a low squat with both HANDS flat on the mat shoulder-width apart, arms bent, her KNEES resting on the backs of her upper arms, both feet LIFTED OFF the mat, balancing entirely on her hands, looking forward.
boat: Change her pose: she balances on her sitting bones — both legs LIFTED OFF the mat, stretched straight and together at a 45 degree angle, torso leaning slightly back, body forming a V shape, arms stretched straight forward parallel to the mat.
child: Change her pose: from all fours she sits her HIPS BACK ONTO HER HEELS, chest folded down over her thighs, FOREHEAD resting on the mat, arms stretched out in front of her with palms on the mat.
warrior3: Small correction: her standing foot is firmly FLAT on the mat with the leg vertical and straight — she balances clearly on that grounded leg, back leg lifted straight and horizontal behind her, torso horizontal, arms stretched forward.
camel: Change her pose: she KNEELS UPRIGHT on the mat — knees and shins on the mat, thighs and torso vertical — then arches her back backward, chest opening up toward the ceiling, hands reaching back to her heels.
low-lunge: Small correction: her BACK KNEE now rests ON the mat (shin and top of the foot flat on the mat behind her), front knee bent above the ankle, torso upright, arms raised overhead — a low lunge, not a high lunge.
head-to-knee: Change her pose: she sits with her LEFT leg stretched straight out in front of her on the mat, her right knee bent with the sole of the right foot against her left inner thigh, and folds her torso FORWARD over the straight leg, hands reaching toward the left foot.
side-angle: Change her pose: she is in a wide lunge with her front knee bent, back leg straight, her front FOREARM resting on the front thigh, and her other arm stretched straight overhead past her ear creating one line from back foot to fingertips, torso leaning toward the front leg.
reverse-plank: Change her pose: she sits then presses up into a REVERSE plank facing the ceiling — hands on the mat behind her hips with straight arms, hips lifted UP, body in one straight line, heels on the mat, chest and belly facing UP.
king-pigeon: Change her pose: her right leg is folded in front of her flat on the mat (shin across), her left leg stretched straight back behind her flat on the mat, hips low and square, torso upright, hands on the mat beside her hips.
marichyasana-a: Change her pose: she sits with her left leg stretched straight on the mat, right knee bent with the right foot flat on the mat close to her hip, and TWISTS her torso toward the bent knee, right arm wrapping around the bent leg, looking over her shoulder.
hand-to-big-toe: Change her pose: standing on her left leg, she lifts her RIGHT leg STRETCHED COMPLETELY STRAIGHT out in front of her at hip height, holding her right foot with her right hand, left hand on her hip, back upright.
side-plank: Change her pose: she is in a SIDE plank facing the viewer — balancing on her right hand with the right arm straight and vertical, body turned sideways in one straight diagonal line, feet stacked, her left arm pointing straight up to the ceiling.
standing-quad-stretch: Change her pose: standing on her left leg, she bends her RIGHT knee and brings her right foot up BEHIND her toward her buttock, holding the right ankle behind her with her right hand, left arm out for balance, knees together.
bird-dog: Change her pose: from all fours she stretches her RIGHT ARM straight FORWARD horizontal at shoulder height AND her LEFT LEG straight BACK horizontal at hip height, back flat, balancing on the other hand and knee.
seated-twist: Small correction: she TWISTS her torso further toward her bent knee and looks back OVER HER SHOULDER, her opposite elbow pressing against the outside of the bent knee.
